data.name: Chaturaanan
data.gender_notes: Chaturaanan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chatura’ meaning ‘four’ and ‘anana’ meaning ‘armed’. This name refers to the four arms of various Hindu deities, symbolizing power, protection, and abundance. The name Chaturaanan carries the meaning “Four-armed” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chaturaanan usually hope their child will grow to embody four-armed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chaturaanan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Four-armed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chaturaanan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the number four represents the four pillars of dharma (righteousness), artha (prosperity), kama (desire), and moksha (liberation). The name Chaturaanan connects one spiritually to these core aspects of life through the divine example of gods and goddesses with four arms, instilling a sense of balance, strength, and purpose.
